data.heading: Answers to the most common questions

items.question: What types of courses do you offer?
items.answer: We offer short courses and certificate programmes in technology, business, design and personal development, from beginner to advanced level.

items.question: Can I learn at my own pace?
items.answer: Yes. Most courses are self-paced with optional live sessions, so you can fit your studies around work and family.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate?
items.answer: Every course ends with a certificate of completion that you can share with employers and on your professional profiles.

items.question: How do I enrol in a course?
items.answer: Choose a course, select Enquire or Join, and our admissions team will guide you through registration and payment options.

items.question: Can I access courses on my phone?
items.answer: Yes. All course materials work on phones, tablets and computers, and many lessons can be downloaded to watch offline.

services.name: Digital Marketing Fundamentals
services.description: Plan campaigns, grow an audience on social media and measure what works.
services.content:
Learn how to plan a digital campaign from start to finish. You will practise writing for social media, running small ad budgets and reading analytics, then present a complete campaign for a real local business.

  • 6 weeks, self-paced
  • Weekly live Q&A
  • Certificate of completion

services.name: Introduction to Web Development
services.description: Build and publish your first websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
services.content:
Start from zero and finish with a portfolio of three published websites. The course covers HTML structure, modern CSS layout and the JavaScript you need to make pages interactive.

  • 10 weeks
  • Mentor code reviews
  • Certificate of completion

services.name: Graphic Design Basics
services.description: Learn layout, colour and typography, and design for print and screen.
services.content:
Understand the principles behind good design and apply them to posters, social posts and simple brand identities. No previous experience needed.

  • 8 weeks
  • Project feedback from designers
  • Certificate of completion

services.name: Python Programming for Beginners
services.description: Write your first programs and automate everyday tasks with Python.
services.content:
A friendly introduction to programming. You will write small programs, work with files and data, and finish by automating a task from your own work or studies.

  • 8 weeks
  • Hands-on exercises every lesson
  • Certificate of completion

news.title: The Power of Lifelong Learning: Why It's Never Too Late to Start
news.excerpt: Learning new skills at any age keeps your career moving and your mind sharp.
news.content: Many of our learners come back to study after years at work. They tell us the same thing: starting was the hardest part. Here is why it is worth it, and how to make the first step easier.

news.title: Balancing Work and Study: Tips for Busy Learners
news.excerpt: Practical routines that help working professionals finish their courses.
news.content: Short, regular study sessions beat long weekend marathons. We asked graduates how they fitted learning around full-time jobs and families.

news.title: 5 Study Habits to Help You Learn Faster
news.excerpt: Simple, research-backed techniques that make new knowledge stick.
news.content: Spaced repetition, teaching others and practising with real problems are three of the most effective ways to learn. Here is how to use them in any course.
